thread:
maria: FYI merged crypto-provider@2.1.3 that includes the KMS client auth fix and an RBAC change (kms.read -> kms.decrypt split). Need a quick post-patch verification plan before we ramp.
ton y: good catch. quick wins: smoke tests + stage canary. do we have an e2e that hits KMS paths?
maria: yes, test-suite/kms_e2e.sh covers decrypt path. it uses test-key-1 in staging. will kick it off now.
ops-bot: deploy completed: crypto-provider 2.1.3 deployed to staging (rev: d4c3b2a) :white_check_mark:
lydia: for RBAC, we should run the role matrix check. quick script:

```
./tools/rbac-check --principal=redwood-kms-svc --perm=kms.decrypt
```

should return explicit allow for the service principal.

also watch for any 403 spikes in audit logs.
dennis: add these Prom queries to the watchlist:
- KMS auth failures: sum(rate(kms_auth_fail_total[5m]))
- API error rate: increase from baseline: sum(rate(http_requests_errors_total[5m])) by (route)
- Latency p95 for decrypt: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/kms/decrypt"}[5m])) by (le))
amanda: for post-patch perf regression check, run the microbenchmark harness against the new runtime:

```
make bench-kms
# compare with baseline stored at /bench/baselines/crypto-provider-2.1.2.json
```

if p95 increases > 10% we stop the rollout.
maria: plan I'm proposing:
1) run rbac-check + kms_e2e.sh in staging (now)
2) run bench-kms and compare baseline (now)
3) stage canary: 1 instance, 30m watch
4) prod canary: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 90m with automated rollback on alerts

we need exact alert thresholds to trigger rollback.
lydia: suggested alert thresholds:
- KMS auth failures > 5/min sustained for 3m
- route error rate increase > 200% vs baseline for 5m
- latency p95 increase > 10% for 10m
tony: add audit-log verification: ensure each decrypt call emits an entry with fields {principal, key_id, method, request_id}. Loki query (example):

```
{job="audit-logs"} | json | principal="redwood-kms-svc" | key_id="test-key-1" | method="decrypt"
```

if entries stop appearing that's a red flag.
maria: started staging runs: rbac-check -> OK, kms_e2e -> passed 12/12, bench-kms running.
ops-bot: bench-kms finished: p95 delta vs 2.1.2 = +3% (within tolerance)
amanda: good. proceed to single-instance stage canary.

ops-bot: canary rotated: crypto-provider@2.1.3 -> 1/1 instance in staging (id: canary-stage-11)

maria: during the 30m watch I'll monitor these dashboards: kms/auth-errors, api/errors, latency/p95, audit-log-rate. tagging watchers @tony @lydia @amanda
devex-bot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-patch-verify (contains rollback steps and playbook)
dennis: reminder — ensure we have a pre-created rollback image pinned in the deploy pipeline (crypto-provider@2.1.2) and the feature-flag enabled for fast rollback.
maria: stage canary healthy at 30m. no auth failures, audit entries present and correct, p95 delta +2%.
maria: starting prod canary: 5% -> watching.
amanda: set temporary alert with auto-escalation: if any threshold fires, page oncall and hold rollout.
tony: also watch long-tail TLS handshake errors — new client change touched TLS config. prometheus: sum(rate(tls_handshake_errors_total[5m]))
maria: prod canary at 25% now. everything green so far.
ops-bot: prod canary progress: 5% -> 25% -> 100% scheduled over 90m. automation will pause on paging alerts.
maria: after ramp completes, we'll run a quick audit-log sweep to ensure all decrypt events include the new 'auth_method' field added in 2.1.3.
lydia: post-rollout tasks: update docs for RBAC change (kms.read split) + notify infra teams about permission update.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging final checklist:
- [x] staging smoke
- [x] perf bench within threshold
- [x] stage canary healthy
- [x] prod canary ramp started (automation in place)
- [ ] update RBAC docs and notify teams

amanda: I'll own the docs update.
maria: will follow up if any alerts. :thumbsup:
